summary: S04T03 added directive documentation coverage for workflows and installed skills. Workflow docs tests now require exactly one Agent Directives section, required directive guidance markers, and valid workflow references. Installed Codex and Claude skill tests now assert exactly one Agent Directive Handling section. The missing directive section in 27 older workflows was repaired with the standard trusted-directive handling guidance and explicit step ordering.
command: git diff --check -- workflows tests/runtime/workflow-docs.test.ts tests/runtime/cli.test.ts; pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime/workflow-docs.test.ts; pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime/cli.test.ts -t 'installs Codex and Claude skill files and keeps dry-run read-only|reports stale or target-mismatched installed skills|lists workflows, shows workflow markdown, plans skill installs, and doctors skill assets'; bwrk docs check --json; bwrk sync refresh --json; bwrk doctor --strict --json
